name: Rossignol Evo XC 60 Tour Cross Country Ski Package (Cross Country Skis, Boots, Bindings, Poles)
description: **Skis, boots & poles are selected according to the customer's height, weight, and shoe size to ensure the proper fit and performance.** Click "Customize Now" to provide your sizing information. This ski package performs well both on groomed trails and out your back door, and is everything you need for your XC ski adventure! Rossignol Evo XC 60 Tour No-Wax Skis. Ski weight 1360 grams for size 176cm. Side cut 60-50-55mm. Sizes 166cm, 176cm, 186cm, 196cm. Ski length is selected for customer based on skier's weight. Nationally best selling cross country skis because they are lightweight, stable, get great glide, and are incredibly versatile. Positrack grip pattern gets great traction. Mid-length design make skis responsive, stable, and easy to control. Use on and off trail 50/50. MSRP: $241 Salomon Escape Prolink Boot (Mens) or Salomon Vitane Prolink Boot (Womens). This warm, comfortable boot has the Salomon Touring fit, a lace cover with central zip, mono-material outsole, over the ankle upper, and internal heel reinforcement. The Womens Vitane Boot adds womens fit and fleece lining. The most popular recreational XC boot for a good reason! MSRP: $115 Turnamic Control Bindings (installed). These automatic step-in bindings, which slide onto a pre-mounted plate, are intuitive and easy to use. Wide binding plate and secure binding attachment allow for maximum power transfer to the skis. With quick, tool-free adjustment capability, they are easy to adjust forward and back. No grip? No problem, simply move the binding forward! Not enough glide? Just slide the binding back. MSRP $69 Swix ST102 Trail pole with universal basket, sturdy aluminum shaft, and adjustable straps. Sizes: 120cm to 160cm.
